title: 電気回路Ⅲ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Electric Circuits III
teachers:
AIZAWA Koji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this class, including a review of Electric Circuit I and II, contents from the basic circuit combining resistance (R), inductance (L) or capacitance (C) and their combination to a slightly more complex AC circuit are learned. In the calculation of an AC circuit, it is no exaggeration to say that it is common sense to use a so-called symbolic solution using phasors and complex numbers. In the subsequent course Electric Circuit IV, the circuit analysis techniques using symbolic solution becomes the base for learning more advanced and complex analysis methods.
advice:
1 Mutual induction
2 Useful theorems
3 Two-port circuit
4 Phasor trajectory

In addition, since the progress is adjusted while confirming the degree of understanding from the result of the quiz or the like, the schedule of the class and the learning content may be changed. Active learnings, that is, exercises, quizzes, presentation discussions, questions and answers, short breaks, etc. are conducted so that students concentrate on classes. Depending on the presence of Humanity and Nature Seminar, times and contents of review class may change (follow the instructions of the professor in charge)
books: Basic electric circuit(2nd edition)New Edition, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: In this course, it is important to solve more problems in order to understand the theory and put it into practice. Moreover, since it is the accumulation of learning one by one, daily continuous efforts are required. Therefore, you are required to do things like 1. Check various reference books, 2. Ask the professor in charge, 3. Use the Mathematics Education Center so that you can always clear things that you do not understand. In this classes, Mathematics such as simultaneous linear equations, determinants, matrices, differentiation / integration, basics of complex numbers, and trigonometric functions are utilized.

activityGoals.body: The mutual induction phenomenon can be explained. The basic mutual induction can be analyzed.
The electric circuits can be solved using useful theorems.
In a two-terminal pair circuit, calculations using at least Z, Y, and F matrix.
The problem of phasor trajectory can be solved using symbolic solutions.

achievementLevels.ideal: Slightly complicated problems of mutual induction circuit as in an application problem can be analyzed using symbolic solutions. Slightly complicated problems of electric circuit can be solved using  useful theorems.  Slightly complicated problems of derivation of Z, Y, and F parameters and transform from T-type to π-type (or vice versa) equivalent circuit as in application problems are solved. Slightly complicated problems of phasor trajectory are solved.  In order to achieve the above levels, the average for the exams, quizzes and reports is over 85%.
achievementLevels.standard: Basic problems of mutual induction circuit can be analyzed using symbolic solutions. Basic problems of electric circuit can be solved using useful theorems. Basic problems of derivation of Z, Y, and F parameters and transform from T-type to π-type (or vice versa) equivalent circuit are solved. Basic problems of phasor trajectory are solved. In order to achieve the above levels, the average for the exams, quizzes and reports is over 75%.
